style.name: norse-frontier-v2
style.base: hand painted stylized 3D game art, norse viking frontier village, dark stained pine timber, turf sod roofs, crimson and bronze banners, cool blue-green moss, warm firelight in small windows

focus.building: painterly hand painted surfaces, visible wood grain on every plank and log, chiselled stone detail, green moss in the cracks and along the roof edges, weathered worn edges, warm golden light from the upper left, soft painterly brush texture, rich material detail, isometric diorama on its own small grassy yard, plain light grey background
focus.card: painterly hand painted surfaces, visible wood grain, chiselled stone, moss and weathering, warm golden light from the upper left, soft painterly brush texture, isometric diorama on a small grassy yard, plain light grey background
focus.wall_surface: flat straight-on game texture of a fortification surface filling the whole frame, painterly wood grain and stone detail, moss in the joints, weathering, even soft light, seamless
focus.terrain: seamless top-down ground texture filling the whole frame, painterly hand painted detail, even soft light, uniform density, no objects, no focal point, no vignette
focus.backdrop: painted landscape backdrop, soft painterly brush texture, atmospheric depth, pale clear sky, no buildings, no people, no text

notes: Warbands village art V2. A building's picture changes every 10 levels (three looks at most); the wall has three tiers. Blender owns the geometry, FLUX paints the surfaces, the gates decide.
